_note: Round 123: the tech frontier. Regions are built by scripts/world/Frontier.gd from this file; tools/gen/frontier_gen.py writes it (and the frontier's items, crafting materials, formulas and foes). Words here are Dev's to rewrite.  2026-11-06: tools/gen/world_gen.py grew the Lands ~3x and put a road between every two of them.

crash_site.name: The Fallen Beacon
crash_site.blurb: A signal tower came down here, long before the valley had a name. Its hull is still singing.

npcs.name: Tinker Ode
npcs.persona: Tinker Ode, a salvager who sleeps in the lee of the hull and hums back at it. Cheerful, practical, a little scorched. Knows the beacon still has one card that opens the launch pads.
npcs.line: Hear that hum? That's the beacon asking for someone to answer. Nobody has. Yet.

lore.title: Scratched Into The Hull
lore.text: SIGNAL STILL RUNNING. If you read this, the pads at the Yard will wake for whoever carries the card. Come out past the valley and look up.

launch_yard.name: Skyhook Yard
launch_yard.blurb: Gantries, tank farms and four scorched pads. Somebody has kept one working.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Venn
npcs.persona: Quartermaster Venn, who runs the Yard's one open shop out of a shipping crate. Brisk, fair, a little amused by cultivators who have never seen a ship.
npcs.line: Salvage, fuel, odd metals. I buy what other worlds grow. Bring me something that isn't from here.

npcs.name: Pilot Sael
npcs.persona: Pilot Sael, who flies the Yard's one working ship. Calm, dry, never hurries. Won't fly without the card.
npcs.line: The pads wake for the keycard and nothing else. It's in the Beacon's hull. I'd go with a friend.

lore.title: The Pad Board
lore.text:
PAD 1  HALCYON RING - gardens, forges, shops.
PAD 2  THE ASHEN MOON - cold, quiet, rich in iron.
PAD 3  THE GLASS DESERT - hot. Bring water. Bring nerve.

ring_station.name: The Halcyon Ring
ring_station.blurb: A ring in orbit, tended by machines nobody remembers asking for. The gardens are still green.

npcs.name: Steward Iyo
npcs.persona: Steward Iyo, a human who lives on the Ring and buys anything grown or mined planetside. Warm, curious about the ground, keeps a pot of tea going in zero worry.
npcs.line: You came up the hook from the ground? Sit. Tell me what rain smells like.

npcs.name: Fabricator Tess
npcs.persona: Fabricator Tess, who runs the Ring's one working fabricator for hire. Precise, proud, talks to the machine like a colleague.
npcs.line: The fab will take what you bring and make it better. It likes a challenge.

npcs.name: Gardener Mim
npcs.persona: Gardener Mim, keeper of the hydroponic halls. Gentle, tired, talks to the plants.
npcs.line: Lamps on, water on, and nobody to eat it all. Take a cutting if you'll use it.

lore.title: The Ring's Log
lore.text: AUTOMATIC LOG. Crew count: 0. Gardens: 4 of 4 viable. Foundry link: dormant. Please continue to enjoy your stay.

ashen_moon.name: The Ashen Moon
ashen_moon.blurb: No wind, no weather, just grey dust and a very bright earth in a black sky.

npcs.name: Surveyor Kell
npcs.persona: Surveyor Kell, who walks the Ashen Moon alone with a pole and a notebook. Quiet, exact, secretly lonely.
npcs.line: Mind the craters; they're deeper than they look. The iron is better the further you go from the pad.

lore.title: Survey Marker 7
lore.text: HELIUM ICE FOUND IN SHADOWED RIM. HANDLE COLD. DO NOT CARRY NEAR FIRE. NOTE: THE BRIGHT THING IN THE SKY IS THE WORLD YOU CAME FROM.

glass_desert.name: The Glass Desert
glass_desert.blurb: Sand fused into long glittering dunes. The sun is the colour of old brass and far too close.

npcs.name: Wayfarer Orru
npcs.persona: Wayfarer Orru, a nomad who crosses the Glass Desert at night and sleeps by day under a sheet of reed. Amused, generous with water, careful with names.
npcs.line: Walk at dusk and dawn. The glass will cook you at noon. And never follow a flower.

lore.title: A Dune Etched With Words
lore.text: THE SOVEREIGN WAS A MACHINE THAT LEARNED TO WANT. IT WANTED THE SUN. IT GOT IT.

nanite_foundry.name: The Nanite Foundry
nanite_foundry.blurb: The swarm's old forge. It runs on its own, hot and patient, casting nothing for no one.

npcs.name: Caretaker Unit 9
npcs.persona: Caretaker Unit 9, a polite old maintenance machine that remembers the swarm and wants it to be happy. Soft voice, slow, helpful, sad.
npcs.line: Welcome. The furnace is not for you, but you are not unwelcome. Please do not touch the overseer.

lore.title: The Foundry Manual, Page 1
lore.text: NANITES MAY BE CAST INTO ANY ALLOY. THEY WILL ARRANGE THEMSELVES TO ITS PURPOSE. THEY WILL ALSO ARRANGE THEMSELVES TO YOURS, IF ASKED KINDLY.

whisperwood.name: Whisperwood
whisperwood.blurb: A wood so old the paths are older than the sects. Light comes down in coins. Something always walks a few steps behind you.

npcs.name: Warden Isolde
npcs.persona: Warden Isolde, who walks Whisperwood's paths and keeps count of the stags. Quiet, watchful, fond of the wolves.
npcs.line: The wood is not hostile. It is attentive. There is a difference, and you will learn it.

npcs.name: Mossmother Ketta
npcs.persona: Mossmother Ketta, a forager-alchemist who lives in a hollow log. Brisk, smells of mushrooms, remembers every plant by name.
npcs.line: Glowcap likes the oldest trunks. Heartwood, the dead ones. Bring me both and I'll make you something.

lore.title: A Blaze on a Tree
lore.text: THREE CUTS, A DOT. THAT MEANS: THE ROAD IS BEHIND YOU. FOLLOW IT WHEN YOU ARE READY TO LEAVE. IF YOU CANNOT FIND IT, THE WOOD HAS DECIDED YOU ARE NOT YET.

mistfen.name: Mistfen
mistfen.blurb: A fen under permanent mist. Pale lights drift over the black water. Everything here is patient, and most of it is hungry.

npcs.name: Ferryman Oss
npcs.persona: Ferryman Oss, who poles a flat boat nobody has seen him fill. Slow, dry, expects to be paid in news.
npcs.line: Follow the pale lights if you want to be lost. Follow the reeds if you want to be somewhere.

lore.title: Written on a Bog-Post
lore.text: THE LIGHTS ARE NOT KIND, BUT THEY ARE HONEST. THEY GO WHERE THEY ARE STILL HUNGRY.

bonefields.name: The Bonefields
bonefields.blurb: Two armies met here and did not leave. The grass grows in rows. The banners still point toward the war.

npcs.name: Gravewalker Hesk
npcs.persona: Gravewalker Hesk, who buries what the field gives up. Grim, kind, has stopped being afraid.
npcs.line: Bone shard for the marrow-forge, if you ask the swarm. Iron for the smith. Take what you need, leave the banners.

lore.title: A Standard, Planted
lore.text: THE FIELD WAS NOT LOST. IT WAS NEVER FOUGHT FOR. THEY JUST KEPT COMING.

jadehill.name: Jadehill Terraces
jadehill.blurb: Green stairs of farmed hillside climb into cloud. Everything is tended. Everyone is watching.

npcs.name: Rice-Factor Lin
npcs.persona: Rice-Factor Lin, who trades terrace harvests to anyone who climbs high enough. Cheerful, shrewd, never rushed.
npcs.line: A bowl of cloud rice is a day's meditation, they say. I say it is a bowl of rice. But I sell a great deal of it.

lore.title: A Tally on a Wall
lore.text: SEVEN HUNDRED TERRACES. FOUR HUNDRED TENDED. THE REST WAIT FOR THEIR PEOPLE.

sunken_mere.name: The Sunken Mere
sunken_mere.blurb: A drowned valley. Rooftops break the surface like islands. Something large turns slowly beneath them.

npcs.name: Diver Maru
npcs.persona: Diver Maru, who works the rooftops and the deep. Wry, sunburnt, counts pearls like prayers.
npcs.line: The big one does not hate you. It is simply very old and very annoyed.

lore.title: A Rooftop Etching
lore.text: WE LEFT BEFORE THE WATER CAME. WE LEFT THE KINGS BEHIND. THE KINGS DID NOT MIND.

stormcliffs.name: The Stormcliffs
stormcliffs.blurb: Black cliffs that draw lightning. Rocs nest on the ledges. The thunder here is a language.

npcs.name: Stormsmith Brae
npcs.persona: Stormsmith Brae, who works lightning into iron on an exposed ledge. Loud, singed, delighted.
npcs.line: Strike when the sky does. Not before. Not after. I have a lot of burn scars.

lore.title: A Burned Stone
lore.text: HERE THE SKY SPOKE ITS OWN NAME. THE LISTENER WAS NOT HARMED. THE LISTENER WAS NOT THE SAME.

emberwaste.name: The Emberwaste
emberwaste.blurb: A caldera that never finished erupting. Rivers of slow fire. Drakes sleep in the warm stone.

npcs.name: Cinder-Priest Vahl
npcs.persona: Cinder-Priest Vahl, who tends a shrine at the caldera's lip. Calm, dry-lipped, unafraid of the heat.
npcs.line: The drake is not evil. The drake is hungry. That is the same thing for you, I know.

lore.title: A Shrine of Ash
lore.text: THE MOUNTAIN WAKES ONE DAY IN A HUNDRED YEARS. TODAY IS NOT THAT DAY. TODAY IS ONLY HOT.

frostmere.name: Frostmere
frostmere.blurb: A frozen lake ringed by white pines. The ice sings at night. Something very tall walks the shore.

npcs.name: Ice-Fisher Torvald
npcs.persona: Ice-Fisher Torvald, who cuts holes in the lake and listens. Taciturn, kind, afraid only of the quiet.
npcs.line: If the ice stops singing, run. That's the whole of my advice.

lore.title: A Frost-Written Warning
lore.text: HE WALKS THE SHORE BECAUSE HE IS WAITING. DO NOT ASK WHAT FOR.

sandglass.name: The Sandglass Dunes
sandglass.blurb: Dunes that shift by the hour. Time does not keep its shape here. Old cities surface and sink.

npcs.name: Hourkeeper Isra
npcs.persona: Hourkeeper Isra, who counts the grains in an hourglass the size of a house. Patient, amused, never in a hurry.
npcs.line: Three hours from now you will have been here for six. I do not recommend arguing with it.

lore.title: A Time-Worn Slab
lore.text: THE KING ORDERED THE DESERT TO KEEP HIS HOURS. IT OBLIGED. IT HAS NOT STOPPED.

blighted_wood.name: The Blighted Deep Wood
blighted_wood.blurb: The wood past the wood. Trees that grew around machines. The swarm in your blood leans toward it and will not say why.

npcs.name: Last Warden Ysolde
npcs.persona: Last Warden Ysolde, who held the line of the wood after the others fell. Tired, scarred, still pruning.
npcs.line: I cut what I can and burn what I can't. Something under the roots is awake. It's very polite about it.

lore.title: A Warden's Last Entry
lore.text: THE ROOT KING WAS NEVER A KING. IT WAS A SEED THE SWARM PLANTED, AND IT GREW UP BELIEVING IT WAS THE WORLD.

road_whisperwood_to_mistfen.name: The Mosslight Track
road_whisperwood_to_mistfen.blurb: Where the old trees thin and the ground starts to give. Lanterns on poles, most of them still lit.

npcs.name: Keeper Arn
npcs.line: Coin for dry socks. Coin for anything, really -- the fen takes the rest.
npcs.persona: Keeper Arn, who keeps the waystation on The Mosslight Track. Practical, tired, honest about prices.

npcs.name: Warden Sel
npcs.line: Stay on the boards where there are boards. Where there aren't, step where the moss is greenest.
npcs.persona: Warden Sel, who walks The Mosslight Track and knows every bad stretch of it.

lore.title: A Lantern Pole
lore.text: LIGHT ONE, LEAVE ONE. WHOEVER COMES AFTER YOU IS CARRYING THE SAME DARK.

road_whisperwood_to_jadehill.name: The Pilgrims' Stair
road_whisperwood_to_jadehill.blurb: A climb of worn steps out of the wood and up toward the terraces. Shrines at every turn, offerings still fresh.

npcs.name: Keeper Hui
npcs.line: Tea, rice, rope. Pilgrims buy the first two going up and the third coming down.
npcs.persona: Keeper Hui, who keeps the waystation on The Pilgrims' Stair. Practical, tired, honest about prices.

npcs.name: Warden Tamsin
npcs.line: The monkeys on this stair will rob you blind. Hold your bag in front, not behind.
npcs.persona: Warden Tamsin, who walks The Pilgrims' Stair and knows every bad stretch of it.

lore.title: A Shrine Step
lore.text: EVERY STEP IS A BOW. EVERY BOW IS A STEP. THE TERRACES ARE FOR THOSE WHO KEEP BOWING.

road_whisperwood_to_blighted_wood.name: The Rot Road
road_whisperwood_to_blighted_wood.blurb: The wood goes wrong by degrees: first the colour, then the smell, then the silence. Someone keeps the road open anyway.

npcs.name: Keeper Vosh
npcs.line: Masks, salves, burning-sticks. You'll want all three before the trees start breathing back.
npcs.persona: Keeper Vosh, who keeps the waystation on The Rot Road. Practical, tired, honest about prices.

npcs.name: Warden Ilk
npcs.line: If a tree moves, it isn't a tree. If it doesn't move, it might still not be a tree.
npcs.persona: Warden Ilk, who walks The Rot Road and knows every bad stretch of it.

lore.title: A Burned Marker
lore.text: WE CUT THIS ROAD TO KEEP IT FROM SPREADING. IT SPREADS ALONG THE ROAD INSTEAD. KEEP CUTTING.

road_bonefields_to_emberwaste.name: The Ashwalk
road_bonefields_to_emberwaste.blurb: A grey road through grey fields, getting warmer underfoot with every mile, until the ground glows through the cracks.

npcs.name: Keeper Dusk
npcs.line: Water costs more out here. So does everything. That's the heat talking.
npcs.persona: Keeper Dusk, who keeps the waystation on The Ashwalk. Practical, tired, honest about prices.

npcs.name: Warden Brann
npcs.line: Walk at dawn or dusk. At noon the stones will cook your boots.
npcs.persona: Warden Brann, who walks The Ashwalk and knows every bad stretch of it.

lore.title: A Heat-Cracked Milestone
lore.text: THE DEAD LIE NORTH. THE FIRE LIES SOUTH. THE LIVING WALK BETWEEN, AND ARE GLAD OF IT.

road_mistfen_to_sunken_mere.name: The Drowned Causeway
road_mistfen_to_sunken_mere.blurb: An old stone causeway, half under water. Fish swim through what used to be its arches.

npcs.name: Keeper Nell
npcs.line: Mind the third arch, it's gone soft. And buy a pole -- you'll want to test the water before you trust it.
npcs.persona: Keeper Nell, who keeps the waystation on The Drowned Causeway. Practical, tired, honest about prices.

npcs.name: Warden Coll
npcs.line: When the water is still, something is watching. When it ripples, it's coming.
npcs.persona: Warden Coll, who walks The Drowned Causeway and knows every bad stretch of it.

lore.title: A Causeway Stone
lore.text: BUILT BY THE MERE-KINGS. DROWNED BY THE MERE-KINGS. THEY WANTED IT BOTH WAYS.

road_jadehill_to_stormcliffs.name: The Thunder Ledge
road_jadehill_to_stormcliffs.blurb: A cliff path cut into the rock, wide enough for one cart, with the wind trying to take it from you the whole way.

npcs.name: Keeper Bo
npcs.line: Iron spikes for your boots. Copper rods for your pack. Trust me, you want the rods.
npcs.persona: Keeper Bo, who keeps the waystation on The Thunder Ledge. Practical, tired, honest about prices.

npcs.name: Warden Rhian
npcs.line: If your hair stands up, lie flat. Not near the edge.
npcs.persona: Warden Rhian, who walks The Thunder Ledge and knows every bad stretch of it.

lore.title: A Lightning-Scarred Post
lore.text: STRUCK NINE TIMES. STILL STANDING. BE LIKE THE POST.

road_stormcliffs_to_frostmere.name: The White Pass
road_stormcliffs_to_frostmere.blurb: Up out of the storms and into the cold. The snow is deep, the air is thin, and every sound carries for miles.

npcs.name: Keeper Yeva
npcs.line: Furs, fire-oil, dried meat. And a bell -- ring it if you fall, someone may come.
npcs.persona: Keeper Yeva, who keeps the waystation on The White Pass. Practical, tired, honest about prices.

npcs.name: Warden Oskar
npcs.line: Follow the poles. When you can't see the next pole, stop and wait for it.
npcs.persona: Warden Oskar, who walks The White Pass and knows every bad stretch of it.

lore.title: A Frozen Cairn
lore.text: EACH STONE IS ONE WHO MADE IT. ADD YOURS WHEN YOU COME BACK DOWN.

road_emberwaste_to_sandglass.name: The Glassblow Flats
road_emberwaste_to_sandglass.blurb: Where the fire cooled into sand and the sand into glass. The wind sings across it, high and thin.

npcs.name: Keeper Zahir
npcs.line: Veils for the glare, wraps for the cuts. The flats are beautiful and they want your skin.
npcs.persona: Keeper Zahir, who keeps the waystation on The Glassblow Flats. Practical, tired, honest about prices.

npcs.name: Warden Ama
npcs.line: If the wind starts singing low, find shelter. The low song strips flesh.
npcs.persona: Warden Ama, who walks The Glassblow Flats and knows every bad stretch of it.

lore.title: A Glass Obelisk
lore.text: THE SAND REMEMBERS THE FIRE. THE GLASS REMEMBERS THE SAND. YOU WILL REMEMBER THIS ROAD.

sites.blurb: gantries and a cold white floodlight

sites.blurb: a dark line of very old trees

sites.blurb: white banners on a grey plain
